metadata.question: Does the sea surface temperature in the eastern tropical Pacific decrease in November 2021, compared with the long-term average during November?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Use NOAA Optimum Interpolation SST (OISST, daily, 0.25°) because we need sea-surface temperature. - Location: eastern tropical Pacific → lon ≈ –140° to –90°W, lat ≈ 15°S – 5°N; create a small rectangle geometry so total pixels are ≤ 1e9 at 3 km, enough for a mean. - Timeframe: – Nov-2021 images (30 daily images). – Long-term average using the same dataset’s climatology band or, if not present, compute the 30-year average (1991-2020) for the same calendar November days. 2. Masking: SST measures water. (1) Mask land using the “land” QA if present, or (2) simply restrict geometry to open ocean (no land). No cloud mask needed for SST. 3. Logic: Compute mean SST for 1-30 Nov 2021, then mean SST for 1-30 Nov across 1991-2020. If 2021 < historical → A (Yes, decreased). Also output pixel counts to guard against C2. Detect C1 if no images for either period, C3 if any result is None/NaN. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry (eastern tropical Pacific) aoi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-140, -15, -90, 5]) # lon, lat # 2. Monthly mean over Nov-2021 (01–30 Nov) col21 = (ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1').select('sst') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2021, 2021, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(11, 11, 'month'))) sst21 = col21.mean().multiply(0.01) # scale: 0.01 °C # 3. Long-term Nov climatology (1991-2020) – same dataset, same Nov days ltcol = (ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1').select('sst') .filterDate('1991-11-01', '2020-11-30') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(11, 11, 'month'))) sstLT = ltcol.mean().multiply(0.01) # Check at least one image in each collection n21 = col21.size().getInfo() nLT = ltcol.size().getInfo() print(f"Images 2021: {n21} | Images 1991-2020 Nov: {nLT}") if n21 == 0 or nLT == 0: print("C1") # 4. Calculation red = lambda img: ee.Image(img).reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), aoi, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9).get('sst') val21 = sst21.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), aoi, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9).get('sst').getInfo()*0.01 valLT = sstLT.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), aoi, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9).get('sst').getInfo()*0.01 if val21 is None or valLT is None: print("C3") count = sst21.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), aoi, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9).get('sst').getInfo() if count == 0: print("C2") # 5. Result print(f"Nov 2021 SST: {val21:.2f} °C | LT Nov avg: {valLT:.2f} °C") print("A" if val21 < valLT else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry (eastern tropical Pacific)
aoi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-140, -15, -90, 5])   # lon, lat

# 2. Monthly mean over Nov-2021 (01–30 Nov)
col21 = (ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1').select('sst')
          .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2021, 2021, 'year'))
          .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(11, 11, 'month')))
sst21 = col21.mean().multiply(0.01)               # scale: 0.01 °C

# 3. Long-term Nov climatology (1991-2020) – same dataset, same Nov days
ltcol = (ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1').select('sst')
         .filterDate('1991-11-01', '2020-11-30')
         .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(11, 11, 'month')))
sstLT = ltcol.mean().multiply(0.01)

# Check at least one image in each collection
n21 = col21.size().getInfo()
nLT = ltcol.size().getInfo()
print(f"Images 2021: {n21} | Images 1991-2020 Nov: {nLT}")
if n21 == 0 or nLT == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 4. Calculation
red = lambda img: ee.Image(img).reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), aoi, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9).get('sst')
val21 = sst21.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), aoi, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9).get('sst').getInfo()*0.01
valLT = sstLT.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), aoi, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9).get('sst').getInfo()*0.01
if val21 is None or valLT is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
count = sst21.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), aoi, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9).get('sst').getInfo()
if count == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")

# 5. Result
print(f"Nov 2021 SST: {val21:.2f} °C | LT Nov avg: {valLT:.2f} °C")
print("<answer>A</answer>" if val21 < valLT else "<answer>B</answer>")
